title: Accounts Merge
description: Merge overlapping email accounts using Union-Find to group emails belonging to the same user.
pseudocode:
1. parent = {}; for email in emails: parent[email] = email
2. for account in accounts: first = account[1]
3. for i from 1 to len(account)-1: union(first, account[i])
4. groups = defaultdict(list)
5. for email in parent: root = find(email); groups[root].push(email)
6. for root in groups: sort(groups[root]); result.push([name] + groups[root])

steps.note: Initialize Union-Find structure. Each email is its own parent.
Grouping emails by their ultimate root parent.
Sorting individual account lists and formatting the output.
